QA Engineer - D365| Dynamics 365, Playwright, Automation| International Payments and Banking Business 
Salary: RON 225,000 – RON 289,000 gross per year
Location: Hybrid, Bucharest - 3 days in the office, 2 days remote
 Our long-standing client, an international payments and banking business, is building out its Bucharest office as a major tech hub, and this is one of a number of roles they're hiring for there. be the Automation QA Engineer focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), building the automated testing behind the platform that now sits at the centre of the business.
 You'll report into the D365 Centre of Excellence lead and work closely with developers, architects and DevOps. It’s a good time to get in: they have big growth plans for this team and the Bucharest office, and you’ll be one of several hires shaping how it grows.
 Non-Negotiables 
Dynamics 365 Sales / CRM
Playwright
Node.js and TypeScript
C#
API testing: REST, OAuth 2.0, Dataverse Web API
CI/CD: Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions
Strong debugging and problem-solving
 What You'll Work With 
D365 automation frameworks, which you'll build and maintain
Microsoft Graph and REST APIs
Regression, smoke and end-to-end testing across D365 Sales and related modules
Reusable test utilities and scripts in Node.js and C#
Test documentation, traceability and reporting
 Nice to Haves 
Evnt-driven architecture: Kafka
Kubernetes and IaC
 Why Join / Projects 
D365 is now central to the business and its use is expanding into operations, CRM, process automation, data and reporting, and integrations. You'll build the test automation that lets that growth happen safely.
The wider tech function is moving from project-based delivery to a product-led, DevOps-first model, with cloud-native and event-driven architecture and AI on the roadmap.
Bucharest is a growth hub for them, so you're joining a site that's adding teams and roles.
It's a financially strong, regulated business with operations across Europe, the US and beyond.
 If this fits your background, apply and I'll give you a call to talk through the detail.
